title: A file holding the archive of one part of the specification
$comment: The archive holds the nodes that were ever approved and have since been removed (s-f2b5zvc565s242f). The schema requires of a node of the archive only what s-hw84ynkvhgzcnpr lists: a location and a kind, the reason for its removal, and no sid, no node under it and no link pointing at it (s-bpdqd9v72wg7vsz). It admits every other property of the node in any form, so that a node removed under an earlier release or of a kind no longer defined stays readable.

schemaVersion.$comment: The version of this structure the file was written in, as in a file of the specification.

scope.$comment: The part of the specification the archived nodes were removed from.

section.$comment: The name of the file within the archive.

nodes.$comment: The archived nodes, in the order they were archived.

archivedNode.$comment: A removed node as it last stood, with the reason for its removal. It has no sid, so that nothing names it: a node may be deleted from the archive at any time.

refs.$comment: Only the links the node made: none points at it.

archived.$comment: When and why the node was removed, and, where the entry names one, the sid of the node that replaced it at the time of the removal (s-f2b5zvc565s242f). Nothing keeps that sid current.
